description: AGSC-03-19 and AGSC-03-20: foreign link names are mapped on import and never added to the vocabulary — refines becomes narrower, conflicts-with becomes excludes, blockedBy becomes blocked-by and tests becomes verifies. Derivation over one OKF document with those four keys: the mapped frontmatter carries the four Link keys with the same targets, none of the four foreign spellings survives, and each mapping is reported once as the AGSC-E506 warning of AGSC-01-22 (a foreign construct carried across with a note), so four such warnings are expected for the links and no error; the document declares a type, a title, prov and an established licence (CC0-1.0), so the licence record of AGSC-01-22 (status: draft and a further AGSC-E506) is not in play, no other AGSC-E506 is raised, and the case isolates the mapping by its input alone.
reason: 2026-10-29: the case counts exactly four AGSC-E506 warnings for a licensed record and says the draft record 'is not in play'; from 1.1 every foreign record arrives as a draft with one more AGSC-E506 (AGSC-01-22, AGSC-00-14). Republished as imp-0010.
